summary.business_type: Service-area business - single-operator web agency, Thane, Maharashtra
top_findings: 542 lines of uncommitted SEO work (titles, OG image, Person/FAQ schema, pricing, /about, /privacy) are not deployed; production runs commit 738d638 from 31 Aug 2026
No page title contains a commercial or geographic keyword, or the full brand name 'Coreline Digital'
All 10 portfolio sample pages are unreachable to crawlers: robots.txt Disallow makes their noindex unenforceable, and 13 internal links point into the blocked directory
Site is critically thin: ~1,450 words across 4 pages, no blog, no case studies, /services at 370 words
No Google Business Profile signal, no reviews, no citations, no sameAs - the largest missing local traffic source
quick_wins: Review, commit and deploy the SEO working tree (1-2 h, very high impact)
Claim and complete Google Business Profile (2 h, very high impact)
Resolve the /samples/ robots.txt vs noindex conflict (30 m, high impact)
Add sameAs links to org schema and footer (1 h, medium-high impact)
Add alt="Coreline Digital" to the nav logo link (5 m)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS enforced with 308 on apex and www
Canonical host consolidated on www
Valid robots.txt with Host and Sitemap directives
Valid sitemap.xml matching canonicals
Self-referencing absolute canonicals on all pages
html lang=en-IN, charset and viewport correct
True 404 status on unknown paths
Trailing-slash normalisation
Statically prerendered, Vercel edge cache HIT, 88ms TTFB

findings.title: robots.txt Disallow makes the noindex on /samples/ unenforceable
findings.description: /samples/ is Disallowed in robots.txt while every sample page also serves 'noindex, nofollow, nocache'. Google cannot read a meta tag on a page it may not fetch, so the noindex never takes effect and the URLs stay eligible for URL-only indexing.
findings.recommendation: Pick one mechanism: remove Disallow: /samples/ and let the noindex work, or keep the Disallow and drop the meta tag.

findings.title: 13 internal links point into a crawler-blocked directory
findings.description: The homepage links to 3 sample pages and /work links to all 10. Of /work's 12 outbound links, 10 terminate at blocked URLs, making the portfolio page a near dead-end for crawlers.
findings.recommendation: Resolve the robots conflict so the sample pages become crawlable, or stop linking to them from indexable pages.

findings.title: Sitemap lists 4 URLs while local sitemap.ts declares 6
findings.description: app/sitemap.ts already includes /about and /privacy; both return 404 in production because the routes are not deployed.
findings.recommendation: Deploy the working tree, then verify both return 200 and resubmit the sitemap.

findings.title: Security headers largely absent
findings.description: Only Strict-Transport-Security is present. Missing X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, X-Frame-Options/CSP frame-ancestors, and Permissions-Policy. HSTS also lacks includeSubDomains and preload.
findings.recommendation: Add the headers block to next.config.ts.

findings.title: Two-hop redirect from apex over HTTP
findings.description: http://corelinedigital.in redirects to https://corelinedigital.in and then to https://www.corelinedigital.in.
findings.recommendation: Collapse to a single hop to the final HTTPS+www target.

findings.title: /favicon.ico returns 404
findings.description: Icons are served via /icon.svg and /apple-icon.png. Some legacy crawlers and link-preview bots still request /favicon.ico at the root.
findings.recommendation: Add a root favicon.ico fallback.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Copy is specific, confident and free of generic agency filler
Clear differentiated positioning (systems vs templates) sustained across pages
Concrete service descriptions naming real mechanisms - WhatsApp routing, booking calendars, follow-up sequences
Memorable quotable lines well suited to AI citation

findings.title: No content engine at all
findings.description: Four pages, no blog, no guides, no case studies. Nothing targets informational or long-tail queries; every page is bottom-of-funnel. Total indexable body copy is roughly 1,450 words.
findings.recommendation: Launch a blog at 2 posts/month and publish 3 real case studies with outcome numbers.

findings.title: Zero geo or commercial keyword presence in body copy
findings.description: 'Thane' appears in live body text only in the footer address. The site never describes itself using the words buyers search: website design, web developer, website company, paired with Thane, Wagle Estate, or Mumbai.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite homepage and services copy around the 15 terms already identified in the local seoKeywords list.

findings.title: E-E-A-T signals are minimal
findings.description: Founder is 'Shailesh' - first name only, no surname, bio, photo, credentials, or LinkedIn. No sameAs, no named clients, no testimonials, no reviews, no live pricing, and the About page 404s.
findings.recommendation: Deploy the About page and expand it with a full bio, photo, experience and social profiles.

findings.title: Portfolio is samples but the homepage implies client work
findings.description: The homepage section reads 'Recent builds / A few systems we've built' while /work describes the same items as 'Ten industry sample builds'. The working tree already contains an FAQ answering this honestly.
findings.recommendation: Deploy the FAQ and align the homepage heading with /work's framing.

findings.title: /services is critically thin
findings.description: 370 words covering three distinct service lines, on the primary money page.
findings.recommendation: Expand to 900+ words with an H3 per 'Includes' item.

findings.title: Contact page has no subheadings
findings.description: /contact carries an H1 and no H2 or H3 at all, across 97 words.
findings.recommendation: Add Visit / Call / WhatsApp / What happens next subheadings.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: One unique descriptive H1 per page
Self-referencing canonicals correct sitewide
Meta descriptions present on every page
No duplicate titles or descriptions
Correct index,follow robots directives on public pages

findings.title: No title contains a commercial or geographic keyword
findings.description: Not one title says website, web design, Thane or Mumbai. Titles use internal positioning vocabulary such as 'Digital Infrastructure' and 'Digital Storefronts & Systems' that carries effectively no search volume.
findings.recommendation: Deploy the working tree, whose titles are already geo-targeted ('Websites for Thane Businesses', 'Website Design in Thane').

findings.title: Full brand name absent from every title
findings.description: Titles suffix with 'coreline.' but the registered name is Coreline Digital, so brand searches match against a string the titles never contain.
findings.recommendation: Use '| Coreline Digital' as the title suffix.

findings.title: og:image missing sitewide
findings.description: No og:image on any page and twitter:card is 'summary' rather than 'summary_large_image', so every WhatsApp, LinkedIn and Slack share renders as a bare text link. The code identifies WhatsApp link sharing as the primary distribution channel.
findings.recommendation: Deploy app/opengraph-image.tsx, which already generates a 1200x630 card.

findings.title: Open Graph tags incomplete
findings.description: og:type, og:locale and og:site_name are all absent in production. All three are present in the working tree.
findings.recommendation: Deploy the working tree.

findings.title: Titles under-length
findings.description: Titles run 32-41 characters against a ~60 character budget, leaving roughly 20 characters of keyword space unused per page.
findings.recommendation: Extend titles with service and location terms.

findings.title: Two meta descriptions under-length
findings.description: /work is 119 characters and /contact 95, against a ~155 budget. /contact omits the phone number and the same-day callback hook.
findings.recommendation: Expand both toward 150 characters.

findings.title: Flat heading structure on key pages
findings.description: /services uses four H2s and zero H3s for its 'Includes' feature lists; /contact has no subheadings at all.
findings.recommendation: Introduce H3s to improve passage-level extraction.

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList
findings.description: No breadcrumb markup. Low impact on a flat 4-page site.
findings.recommendation: Add once /about and /privacy ship.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid JSON-LD, parses cleanly, no syntax errors
Stable @id anchoring with correct publisher cross-reference
Complete PostalAddress including postalCode
GeoCoordinates present
areaServed covers Thane, Thane West, Mumbai and Maharashtra
ContactPoint with availableLanguage English, Hindi, Marathi
hasOfferCatalog with five typed Service offers
Referenced logo assets both resolve 200

findings.title: No sameAs property
findings.description: No social or third-party profile links in the schema or anywhere on the page. This is the primary mechanism by which Google reconciles a business into its Knowledge Graph.
findings.recommendation: Add Google Business Profile, LinkedIn, Instagram and directory URLs to sameAs and the footer.

findings.title: No founder or Person entity live
findings.description: The homepage devotes a section to Shailesh but no Person entity exists in the markup. personJsonLd() is written and wired in the working tree but unshipped.
findings.recommendation: Deploy the working tree.

findings.title: No openingHoursSpecification
findings.description: LocalBusiness subtypes are eligible for hours display, and the contact page promises a same-day reply before 6pm.
findings.recommendation: Encode business hours in the schema.

findings.title: No aggregateRating or review markup
findings.description: No review markup because no reviews exist.
findings.recommendation: Collect Google reviews first, then mark them up.

findings.title: Identical schema on all four pages
findings.description: Every page emits the same organization graph and nothing page-specific. Missing WebPage per URL, ContactPage, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList and ItemList for the /work grid.
findings.recommendation: Deploy faqJsonLd() (already wired into the services page) and add per-page WebPage types.

findings.title: priceRange '$$' is uninformative
findings.description: A US-dollar band on an Indian INR business.
findings.recommendation: Deploy the working tree's priceSpecification of INR 15,000-35,000.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: 88ms TTFB on Vercel edge cache HIT
~310 KB total page weight excluding photography
Brotli/gzip compression active
Images served as AVIF with correct srcset and sizes
Explicit width/height or fill on every image, keeping CLS risk low
Fonts preloaded with crossorigin and immutable hashed URLs
Below-fold images correctly lazy-loaded
Above-fold logo preloaded via imageSrcSet

findings.title: Core Web Vitals could not be measured
findings.description: The PageSpeed Insights API returned HTTP 429 (daily quota exhausted, no API key configured) and the Claude SEO runtime is not set up, so no CrUX field data was available. No LCP, INP or CLS values were obtained; this score reflects direct transfer measurements only.
findings.recommendation: Configure a PSI API key or run Lighthouse locally, then re-score this category.

findings.title: Four font files across three families
findings.description: Space Grotesk, Inter and IBM Plex Mono total roughly 90 KB, with 48 KB in a single face, all preloaded and competing for early bandwidth.
findings.recommendation: Subset to the Latin range and consider reducing three families to two.

findings.title: All photography hotlinked from Unsplash
findings.description: Every photo proxies images.unsplash.com through the Vercel optimizer, adding a third-party dependency on the critical path for /work.
findings.recommendation: Self-host imagery, ideally replacing stock with real build screenshots.

findings.title: 47 KB of RSC flight payload inline in the HTML
findings.description: self.__next_f.push(...) accounts for 47 KB of the 88 KB uncompressed document - more than half the HTML is hydration data rather than content.
findings.recommendation: Normal for the App Router; reduce client component boundaries where practical.

findings.title: src fallback resolves to the 3840px variant
findings.description: Next.js sets the largest srcset entry as the src fallback, so any client ignoring srcset pulls 663 KB of 4K imagery on /work.
findings.recommendation: Cap the configured deviceSizes to a realistic maximum.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: All AI crawlers verified reachable: GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, bingbot, Googlebot all return 200
No user-agent-specific blocks in robots.txt
Content is server-rendered so non-JS crawlers see full text
Clean semantic HTML with proper heading hierarchy
Organization schema provides a structured entity anchor
Distinctive quotable phrasing well suited to extraction

findings.title: Not enough content to cite
findings.description: AI answer engines cite passages. With roughly 1,450 words sitewide and no question-shaped content there is almost nothing to extract. This is the binding constraint on AI visibility.
findings.recommendation: Expand content depth as set out in the Content Quality category.

findings.title: No FAQ or Q&A content live
findings.description: Question-and-answer blocks are the highest-yield GEO format. Five written FAQs and faqJsonLd() exist in the working tree, unshipped.
findings.recommendation: Deploy the working tree.

findings.title: No author or expertise entity
findings.description: No Person schema, author byline, bio or sameAs. LLMs weight identifiable expertise heavily when selecting citations.
findings.recommendation: Deploy personJsonLd() and expand the About page.

findings.title: Portfolio invisible to AI crawlers
findings.description: All 10 sample builds sit under the Disallow: /samples/ path, so the most substantive content on the site cannot be read by any AI crawler.
findings.recommendation: Resolve the robots conflict.

findings.title: No citable facts, figures or definitions
findings.description: No statistics, live pricing, timelines or comparison tables. The single comparison block is two short lines.
findings.recommendation: Deploy the concrete numbers already in the working tree: INR 15,000 and 10 working days.

findings.title: No off-site brand corroboration
findings.description: No reviews, directory listings or social profiles exist to corroborate the business to an LLM.
findings.recommendation: Claim Google Business Profile and build citations.

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: /llms.txt returns 404. Optional and ignored by Google, though some AI tools consume it.
findings.recommendation: Add if convenient; low expected return.

categories.name: Images
what_works: AVIF delivery via the Next.js optimizer
Correct srcset and sizes attributes on content imagery
Dimensions or fill on every image, so no layout shift
Below-fold images lazy-loaded
Content photography carries genuinely descriptive alt text

findings.title: No Open Graph or social share image
findings.description: Nothing to preview when a link is shared. app/opengraph-image.tsx generates a 1200x630 card in the working tree and is unshipped.
findings.recommendation: Deploy the working tree.

findings.title: All imagery is Unsplash stock
findings.description: Every photograph is stock. On a homepage section headed 'Recent builds / A few systems we've built', stock interiors of clinics and showrooms are a credibility risk.
findings.recommendation: Replace with screenshots of the actual sample builds, which also carry keyword-relevant alt text.

findings.title: Logo alt is empty in nav and footer
findings.description: The nav logo is wrapped in the home link, so screen readers announce a link with no accessible name.
findings.recommendation: Set alt="Coreline Digital" on the nav instance; the footer instance may stay decorative.

findings.title: /favicon.ico returns 404
findings.description: Covered in Technical SEO.
findings.recommendation: Add a root favicon.ico fallback.

Before shipping, confirm /admin and /api are noindex and Disallowed
Verify /about and /privacy return 200 and appear in sitemap.xml
Resubmit the sitemap in Search Console and request indexing on all pages

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Claim and complete the Google Business Profile listing
Resolve the /samples/ robots.txt versus noindex conflict
Decide whether the sample builds should be indexable at all
Add location and service keywords to body copy on / and /services
Begin collecting Google reviews

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Expand /services from 370 to 900+ words with an H3 per Includes item
Add sameAs links to the organization schema and the footer
Flesh out the About page with surname, photo, bio, experience and LinkedIn
Align the homepage 'Recent builds' heading with /work's 'sample builds' framing
Add security headers in next.config.ts
Replace stock photography with screenshots of the real sample builds
Add a descriptive alt attribute to the nav logo

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Build 3-5 genuine location and service pages for Thane, Thane West and Mumbai
Launch a blog publishing 2 posts per month
Write 3 real case studies with outcome numbers
Add openingHoursSpecification, BreadcrumbList and per-page WebPage/ContactPage schema
Build citations on JustDial, Sulekha, IndiaMART and LinkedIn with identical NAP
Subset fonts and consider reducing three families to two

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Configure a PageSpeed Insights API key to capture Core Web Vitals
Run /seo setup to unlock CrUX, Search Console and backlink data
Confirm Search Console verification and monitor the indexed page count
Track map-pack position for 'web design Thane' once GBP is live
Re-audit after Phases 0 and 1; expect roughly 56 to 72
